reason: I already take magnesium every night at home, so I don't need it in a sachet to go. $25 to $30 a month is more than the bottle I already have, and it doesn't hit a problem I have.
objection: I already have magnesium at home and take it at night. Paying double for the sachet convenience when I'm home every evening anyway doesn't make sense.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor's blood test showed I was low and said my current kind isn't working, or if the price were close to what I pay for my bottle.
